correctness.rationale: Two independent exhaustive perfect-matching enumerators agree on 44 facets; an independent dynamic 2^20 subset predicate agrees with all 735 faces. Two reversed greedy face pairings each pass all 2320 directed Hasse incidence acyclicity checks with 350 pairs, one critical vertex and 33 critical 2-cells; the discrete-Morse theorem gives a wedge of 33 integral 2-spheres with no attaching ambiguities. Direct mod-two boundary ranks are 19,111,176,44. For all 240 automorphisms, the orientation-signed simplicial trace gives the seven-by-two exact character table. Murnaghan–Nakayama recursion and integer character inner products check the full rational Specht multiplicities and zero full-group invariants. The extracted exact certificate is reproducible with only the Python 3 standard library.

value.rationale: The canonical four-regular five-crown is a natural diagonal-forbidden chessboard test object for perfect-matching extendibility. Its pure 4-complex has 33 integral 2-sphere summands and cannot be shellable, sharply contrasting with the 3-torsion of the full 5-by-5 ordinary chessboard complex. The full 240-automorphism homology character, 21/12 parity split and absence of global invariants are substantive symmetry information not supplied by a Betti count. The claim is a complete meaningful natural finite invariant; no arbitrary parameter slice or unproved family extrapolation is used.
